description: Look up a bare overhead line conductor (AAC, AAAC, ACSR, ACSR/AW: aluminium or alloy wires, with or without a zinc coated or aluminium-clad steel core): send its code, e.g. "242-AL1/39-ST1A" (EN 50182:2001 4.5) or an ACSS code "401-AL0/28-MEHST" (FprEN 50540 clause 4), or an EN 50182 Annex F country table ("F.19") with an optional row. Each row comes back as the standard prints it, with its table, page and country (seen standard): stranding, areas, diameters, mass, rated tensile strength and d.c. resistance at 20 °C, the clauses every conductor keeps (diameter and mass tolerances, lay), and the ACSS build of the same stranding by the final draft FprEN 50540:2009-08 (mass, strength, resistance, each with its clause, seen draft; core picks the core wire). Use it to read an overhead conductor code or compare one country's table with another's; for insulated cables use decode_cable_code. Priced like a decode, on the same free allowance. Deterministic, no LLM.

code.description: A bare overhead conductor code: EN 50182:2001 4.5, the envelope's area and wire then the core's, e.g. "242-AL1/39-ST1A", "65-A20SA", "434-AL1/56-ST1A"; or an ACSS code by FprEN 50540 clause 4, e.g. "401-AL0/28-MEHST", read by its areas. Every Annex F country table that lists it answers.

core.description: The core wire of the ACSS build (FprEN 50540 clause 4): ST6A, EHST, MEHST, UHST, MUHST, 20SA, 20EHSA, 14EHSA; default ST6A, or an ACSS code's own core.

row.description: With table: one conductor code of that table.

table.description: Instead of code (or to narrow it): an EN 50182 Annex F country table (52 tables). Alone it answers every row of the table.

name: overhead_conductor
title: Look up a bare overhead line conductor (EN 50182, ACSS)
